summary: CSRF header defense (X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest on all admin writes) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 17/17 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_csrf_admin.py — covers wrong-password 401, admin endpoint without cookie 401, GET /admin/submissions with and without XRW (both 200 since GETs are exempt), 5 write endpoints returning 403 without XRW header (verify business, crud add, approve submission, delete submission, reply review), CRUD add+delete on cameras/sites/desvios with XRW, full public submission + review flow without XRW (must NOT be affected), and admin approve/reject full flow with XRW. Frontend E2E: admin modal opens from footer, wrong password shows 'Credenciales invalidas', correct login reveals all 6 tabs (pendientes/agenda/camaras/emergencias/sitios/desvios), GET /admin/submissions returns 200, delete of a camera row triggered POST /admin/cameras and DELETE — no 403 seen anywhere from CSRF. Public flows unaffected.

ui_bugs.issue: When an admin CRUD write returns a non-2xx (e.g., 422 from Pydantic when the user submits an empty form or invalid coords), the axios rejection is not caught: React's dev overlay shows a full-page 'Uncaught runtime errors: Request failed with status code 422' that blocks the whole UI. It's not caused by the CSRF change, but the CSRF-header rejection (403 'Solicitud no permitida') would surface the same way if it ever fired. Wrap crud add/del/approve/reject/verify calls in try/catch and show a toast instead.

action_items: In AdminPanel.jsx, wrap admin write calls (crudAdd/crudDel/approve/rejectSubmission/verifyBusiness/replyReview) with try/catch and toast on failure, so 422/403 responses don't trigger the React 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_admin correctly enforces x-requested-with only on non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS — good, matches spec. GETs of /admin/submissions remain reachable without the header.
CORS allow_headers already includes 'X-Requested-With' and allow_credentials=True with explicit origin — required for cookie+header combo to work behind the k8s ingress.
Prior iteration finding (proxy-IP-aware rate-limit / brute-force lockout) still stands and is unrelated to CSRF work.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for admin login+tabs+GETs; admin CRUD writes reach the API correctly (CSRF header travels), but the client lacks error-handling around 4xx responses

seed_data_creation: Test-created rows are all TEST_ prefixed and cleaned up in-test (cameras/sites/desvios add-then-delete). Pending submissions TEST_csrf_pending and TEST_csrf_pending_reject were approved/deleted respectively.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSRF regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_csrf_admin.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_csrf_admin.py -o addopts=`. It requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (auto-loaded via python-dotenv). If AdminPanel gets try/catch around write calls, remove the React error overlay observation from frontend issues.
rca of the issue: Not a CSRF bug. Root cause of the full-page red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay: frontend admin write calls in AdminPanel.jsx are fired without try/catch, so any 4xx axios response propagates as an unhandled promise rejection. React's dev-mode error overlay then shows the AxiosError. Fix: `try { await api.crudAdd(...) } catch(e) { toast.error(...) }` in every admin action handler.
